fl2: Built NLP and agentic RAG workflows using Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain, LangGraph, and llm.
p_ch1: Developed XGBoost churn classifier in R, applying classification, machine learning, two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE, and MCC evaluation.
p_gg1: Constructed a heterogeneous graph of 1,399 cell lines and 16,385 genes (~2.8M edges) using k-NN similarity, Leiden community detection, and clustering with modularity 0.822.
p_gg2: Trained per-gene protein-prediction models for 11,459 genes using OLS, GPU Random Forest ensemble, and Scikit-learn, with resumable chunked GPU training on a free T4.
